name: persistence
description: Key-value + append-only-log persistence API. Other modules (kernel state machine, runtime event bus, planner plans, brain graph) write through this contract. Guarantees atomic per-op durability and monotonic sequence numbers for event-log appends.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: Key within the namespace for get/put/delete.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: { value (for get), sequence (for append), ok: bool, error: string? }

side_effects: append operations take a monotonic sequence number from a per-namespace counter

error_codes.message: A namespace exceeded its configured quota.
error_codes.recovery: Reject the put/append; surface the namespace and quota; do not silently drop.

error_codes.message: A stored value failed its declared schema on load.
error_codes.recovery: Quarantine the corrupt file, return NotFound, log AIOS-EVENT-000030 memory_corrupt.
Fail the op; do not claim success. Callers must degrade (Law 9).
